title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND PROGRAM GENERATION METHOD
abstract: The present technology relates to an information processing device, an information processing method and a program generation method that make it possible to decrease the time before convergence of machine learning. The information processing device is provided with a learning unit for performing machine learning on the basis of a predetermined arithmetic expression for a predetermined batch size, and an adjustment unit for adjusting parameters to be used for computation in the learning unit. When a learning coefficient included in the arithmetic expression is reduced, the adjustment unit adjusts the value of a predetermined parameter included in the arithmetic expression to a value smaller than the value before the reduction of the learning coefficient. The arithmetic expression is the momentum SGD (Stochastic Gradient Descent) expression. The predetermined parameter is a parameter included in the inertial term in the momentum SGD. The present technology can be applied, for example, to nodes for machine learning.
